entities.summary: Dragoș Nicolae Mădăraș is a Romanian-born Swedish professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of No. 191 achieved on 17 July 2023 and a best doubles ranking of No. 420 reached on 14 August 2023. He plays mostly on ITF Men's Tour.
